name: National Museum of African American History and Culture
subcategory: African American history and culture museum
sourceName: African American Historical and Cultural Institutions directory (GU272 / American Ancestors)
notes: The directory lists this Washington, DC institution and describes it as the only national museum devoted exclusively to documenting African American life, history, and culture. The official site states its mission is to capture and share African American history and culture and publishes the address above. Directory focus is not treated as proof of ownership.

name: African American Civil War Memorial Museum
subcategory: African American Civil War history museum
sourceName: African American Historical and Cultural Institutions directory (GU272 / American Ancestors)
notes: The directory lists this Washington, DC museum and describes its mission to preserve and tell the history of the 209,145 United States Colored Troops. The official site publishes the address and phone above and describes the museum as an educational resource. Current official homepage also states reopening is scheduled for September 30, 2026; this record does not infer operating status beyond that statement.

name: Anacostia Community Museum
sourceName: African American Historical and Cultural Institutions directory (GU272 / American Ancestors)
notes: The directory lists the Smithsonian Anacostia Community Museum in Washington, DC and describes its focus on social issues affecting diverse populations in the DC metropolitan area. The official site publishes the address and phone above and states that it documents and preserves community memories, struggles, and successes.
